literal: Those who possess wisdom will know what will happen; those without wisdom are those who cannot know that.
translation: The wise foresee what is to come. The unwise are those who cannot foresee it.
modern: அறிவுடையவர்கள் எதிர்காலத்தில் நடக்கப்போவதை முன்கூட்டியே அறிவார்கள். அறிவில்லாதவர்கள் அதனை அறிய முடியாதவர்கள் ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet defines wisdom as the capacity for foresight. The word 'ஆவது' refers to what will happen in the future or the natural consequences of one's actions. The wise ('அறிவுடையார்') are able to anticipate these outcomes and act accordingly. In contrast, those lacking wisdom ('அறிவிலார்') are characterized precisely by their inability ('அறிகல்லாதவர்') to foresee what is to come.
